ambiguities.message: Pizza & Pitcher Combination serves 4–5 adults. Quantity rule is ceil(guestCount / 4) unless the customer states otherwise.
Brownie tray source text says Serves 45–40. Treated as servesMin=40, servesMax=45.
Full Facility rows listed as 5995 without a dollar sign are stored as $5,995 (599500 cents). Full-facility additional hours 1995 stored as $1,995.
Bowling shoes $3.50 per person are a separate add-on on the bowling product, not folded into the lane rate.
Unlimited Laser Tag 90 minutes is weekends-only as a product constraint, not a resource count.
Laser Tag Arena Saturday $599/hour and 90 minute Sun–Thu $550 are two products.
Bowling 2h rental modeled as $750 default vs $850 Friday–Saturday after 16:00.
Beer Wall is not in either workbook and was not invented as a catalog SKU.
Have a Ball bowling and mini golf are two fulfillment variants. Proposals pick one from the customer attraction choice.
